body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> AMD demonstrated its latest HD technology 'ATI Avivo HD' at CES Unveiled January 5th in Las Vegas, which provides PC users with crisp images, smooth videos and true-to-life colors.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
